formulae.title: Complex quadratic Julia recurrence
formulae.basic_explanation: For each pixel, the complex value z is repeatedly squared and shifted by the fixed complex parameter c. Escape speed controls the visible Julia field.

citation.chicago: Drakopoulos, Vasileios. 2002. "Comparing Rendering Methods for Julia Sets." Journal of WSCG 10 (1-2): 155-161.
